_comment_description: Recommended settings for production deployment with security best practices

server._comment_port: Standard submission port. Use 25 for MX relay, 587 for submission, 465 for implicit TLS
server._comment_security_mode: STARTTLS is recommended for production - widely compatible and secure
server._comment_tls_cert_path: Use Let's Encrypt or your CA-signed certificate
server._comment_tls_key_path: Keep private key secure with proper file permissions (0600)
server._comment_max_email_size: 25MB limit - adjust based on your needs and memory constraints
server._comment_max_concurrent_connections: Limit based on expected load and available resources
server._comment_read_timeout: 5 minutes - allows for slower clients and large emails

credentials._comment: Consider using environment variables or secrets management

webhook._comment: Always use secrets in production for webhook signature verification
Always configure a default webhook to avoid rejecting legitimate mail

_production_checklist.1: Replace all CHANGE_ME placeholders with actual secrets
_production_checklist.2: Use strong, randomly generated passwords (32+ characters)
_production_checklist.3: Store secrets in environment variables or secrets management system
_production_checklist.4: Ensure TLS certificates are valid and not self-signed
_production_checklist.5: Configure proper file permissions on config file (0600)
_production_checklist.6: Set up monitoring and log aggregation
_production_checklist.7: Test webhook endpoints are accessible and responding
_production_checklist.8: Configure firewall rules to restrict SMTP port access
_production_checklist.9: Set up automated certificate renewal (e.g., certbot for Let's Encrypt)
_production_checklist.10: Review and adjust resource limits based on expected load
